features: JSON format, minify and validate with line and column errors, optional key sorting
Base64 (UTF-8 safe, URL-safe variant), URL encode, decode and parse, SHA-1/256/384/512 hashes
JWT decoder that shows exp, iat and nbf as dates and says plainly that it never verifies a signature
UUID v4 generator (1 to 50 at once), unix timestamp converter, and a regex tester with live match and group highlighting
Offline: no network access, only storage to remember your last tool
requirements: A Tend panel running schema-2 (native ESM) extensions
A desktop or mobile browser tab with ES module support
A secure context (https or localhost) for hashing and clipboard copy
release_notes: 1.0.1: Wording now says Tend, the control panel's name. The icon now follows your theme.
